select a.* from (SELECT PBC_PROD_ID,PROD_ID,OPERATE_MODE,IVSTORIENTATION,VDATE,status,RAISE_ENDDATE,ORG_CODE, row_number() OVER (partition BY PBC_PROD_ID ORDER BY NVL(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) DESC) AS myrank FROM pbc_prd_baseinfo_sub) a WHERE a.myrank=1
mapper.select:
SELECT pos.CDATE, pos.PROD_ID, pos.CCY, sum(nvl(pos.BALANCE_QTY,0)) BALANCE_QTY, sum(nvl(pos.BALANCE_AMT,0)) BALANCE_AMT, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2 FROM CHB_PRD_POSITION pos left join chb_prd_baseinfo info on info.prod_id = pos.prod_id and info.status != 'D' and info.fprod_id is null left join chb_prd_baseinfo finfo on finfo.prod_id = pos.prod_id and finfo.status != 'D' and info.fprod_id is not null where 1=1
select #{sub.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},to_char(#{sub.vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyy-mm-dd') from sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
group by pos.CDATE,pos.PROD_ID,pos.CCY,pos.BUY_PLACE,pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2

SELECT to_date(pos.DEALDATE ,'yyyyMMdd') CDATE, pos.FINPROD_ID PROD_ID, pos.CCY, sum(nvl(pos.PRINQTY,0)) BALANCE_QTY, sum(nvl(pos.DEALAMT,0)) BALANCE_AMT, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2 FROM P_INTERF_PRO_CUSTOM_DEAL pos where 1=1 and pos.DEALTYPE='1' and (pos.BUY_PLACE not in('210200','330200','350200','370200','440300') or pos.BUY_PLACE is null)
select #{sub.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},to_char(#{sub.vdate,jdbcType=DATE},'yyyyMMdd') from sysibm.SYSDUMMY1
group by pos.DEALDATE, pos.FINPROD_ID, pos.CCY, pos.BUY_PLACE, pos.CUSTOMER_TYPE2
